publication_status: Published provisional profile — checklist review remains separate

distribution.narrative: Original evidence concerns interception from timber shipped from Taiwan; establishment in Taiwan is not demonstrated.

host_note: Browne (1980:376) states 'ex unidentified log'; no botanical host can be identified.
taxonomy_summary: Platypus dasycauda Browne, 1980. Original publication and subsequent nomenclatural qualifications are documented below.

taxonomic_history.name: Platypus dasycauda
taxonomic_history.note: Original account p. 376; original name and description verified.

nomenclature_note: Original specimens were intercepted at Nagoya from an unidentified log shipped from Keelung; a Taiwanese established population is not demonstrated.

references.label: Browne (1980) I
references.citation: Browne, F. G. (1980). Bark beetles and ambrosia beetles (Coleoptera, Scolytidae and Platypodidae) intercepted at Japanese ports, with descriptions of new species. I. Kontyû, 48(3): 370–379.
